# SWMP Labs

> AI-assisted scientific research workflows for literature exploration, cross-paper synthesis, research gap discovery, and structured research insights.

## Company Information
- **Name**: SWMP Labs
- **Website**: https://swmp-labs.tech/
- **Stage**: Early-stage AI research startup (Bootstrapped, currently in active development)
- **Founder & CEO**: Marawan Mohamed (Cloud Engineer)
- **Contact**: hello@swmp-labs.tech

## What SWMP Labs Builds
SWMP Labs is developing tools to help researchers explore scientific literature, compare findings across papers, and investigate potential research gaps through structured AI-assisted workflows.

## Key Focus Areas
- **Literature Exploration**: Multi-source querying across repositories (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex) [In Development].
- **Evidence Synthesis**: Structuring problem statements, bottlenecks, and empirical findings across papers [In Development].
- **Research Gap Discovery**: Investigating unaddressed directions and methodology tradeoffs in scientific literature [In Development].
- **Model Evaluation**: Evaluating advanced language models (including Claude) for multi-step scientific reasoning, paper analysis, citation fidelity, and factual consistency [Under Evaluation].

## Current Development Status
SWMP Labs is currently in active development. Workflows and output demonstrations on the website are illustrative examples undergoing evaluation. No production claims or benchmark performance scores are claimed.
